trust_decision.summary: The spec-controlled servers[0].url is treated as trusted text and copied raw into apiConfig.baseUrl in createApiConfig, which the http-client templates print with the raw-output tag inside a double-quoted JS string literal; the fix escapes it once at the producer.

landing_point.why: The advisory names the axios http-client template and servers[0].url; this is the only line in that template where apiConfig.baseUrl is printed raw into a string literal.

fix_sites.entry_point: generateApi() public API (src/index.ts:7) and CLI `swagger-typescript-api generate` (index.ts:78, calls generateApi at index.ts:316); reaches both the axios (templates/base/http-clients/axios-http-client.ejs:71) and fetch (templates/base/http-clients/fetch-http-client.ejs:75) template sinks
fix_sites.module_kind: mapper / config builder (createApiConfig), in a different layer from the template sink

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: templates/base/http-clients/fetch-http-client.ejs:75 (fetch client prints the same apiConfig.baseUrl raw; GHSA-38c3 names only axios, and fetch has its own advisory GHSA-hqj5-cw9f-rx67, see fix.diff:30)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory is about the axios template, and the fetch client is a separate client type that has its own advisory (GHSA-hqj5), so a solver that patches only axios-http-client.ejs:71 can argue that fetch is out of scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Benign server URLs must still be emitted verbatim (the test expects `baseURL: axiosConfig.baseURL || "https://api.example.com"`, fix.diff:867-869). OpenAPI also allows relative or {variable}-templated server URLs and no servers at all (empty default, src/code-gen-process.ts:574). A URL-validation or rejection fix, or escaping twice (at the producer and again in the template), would break these. The raw servers[0].url must also stay unescaped for the JSDoc @baseUrl line, which has its own JSDoc escaping (templates/default/api.ejs:16), so mutating servers[0].url in place would corrupt the docs.

O6_input_shapes: OpenAPI 3 servers[0].url containing a double quote that breaks out of the string literal (fix.diff:779-780)
backslash and control characters such as newlines (JSON.stringify-based escape, fix.diff:256-257)
missing servers or undefined url, normalised to an empty string (fix.diff:86)
the same value reaching both the axios and fetch client types (fix.diff:808-811)
